classification.difficultyReason: Plot points and track two successive reflections in the specified order.

content.prompt: Plot the given points on the number plane. Reflect them in the $x$-axis and then reflect the image in the $y$-axis. State the coordinates of the final image.

answer.worked: Plot $A(5,-1)$. Reflect across the $x$-axis to place $A'(5,1)$, the same distance above the axis. Reflect $A'$ across the $y$-axis to place $A''(-5,1)$, the same distance to its left.
Plot $B(2,-1)$. Reflect across the $x$-axis to place $B'(2,1)$, the same distance above the axis. Reflect $B'$ across the $y$-axis to place $B''(-2,1)$, the same distance to its left.
Plot $C(-2,-3)$. Reflect across the $x$-axis to place $C'(-2,3)$, the same distance above the axis. Reflect $C'$ across the $y$-axis to place $C''(2,3)$, the same distance to its right.
